source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 13 (UIF liable amount)
notes: R5 000 salary and a R8 000 overpayment clawback (a negative UIF-applicable earning): UIF-leviable remuneration is -R3 000. G21 p. 13 (UIC Act s5-6): employer and employee each contribute 1% of the remuneration paid or payable in the month; nothing is paid, so nothing is levied: UIF 0.00 each side, not -30.00. Only UIF is asserted. Closed by UF (UIF floored at nil).
